title: Group Excursion of Quebec City and Montmorency Falls
includes: Live commentary on board with character guide
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the best of Quebec City with Quebec Bus Tour’s signature small-group guided tour combining history, culture, and stunning scenery. Meet your passionate bilingual guide in Old Quebec, in front of the Horloge du Jura, and explore the Upper and Lower Towns, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Discover iconic landmarks such as Château Frontenac, Plains of Abraham, and Parliament while enjoying engaging stories about Quebec’s history. Then, head to Montmorency Falls, higher than Niagara Falls, where you’ll have 45 minutes to explore, walk the suspension bridge, and take photos. With its small-group format, this experience offers a relaxed, personalized atmosphere and is one of the best things to do in Quebec City.
